column1: # FORECAST.tsv: census, not proof. Generated by tests/shen-jit/feature_census.py --forecast; do not edit.
# Per family: the stage 0 definitions (of 955) predicted accepted under the merged feature set plus
# that family alone, for the family tasks' count floor. A prediction from a syntactic walk of the
# untrusted norm witness and the count-run ticks; Rocq decides acceptance. Nothing here is validated.
# merged set: emit BASE (Comp today: eq-safe-const, eq-symbol-const; every JitEmitRule<X> hook empty);
#   front fam:cond, fam:sugar, fam:thaw-sugar, fam:trap-sugar (JitFrontSugar.chk_front, chk_front_sound).
# variants: src = what the existing source judge (JitLowerStage0.judge on <f>.forms, judge_split.sh src)
#   would accept with the set's emit features in Comp (cond, type, dynamic-apply transparent; any other
#   rewrite rejects); row "merged" src is the current-set prediction, 148 (Rocq src: 148).
#   direct = source -> norm -> bytecode (emit features and required front families within the set;
#   row "merged" direct is 148: the src set plus 0 needing only merged front families);
#   nf = emit only, on the erased normal form with markers (judge_split.sh nf); tf = emit only,
#   markers dropped (judge_split.sh tf). new = definitions in the set and not in row "merged".
# sha256: of the definition names sorted by UTF-8 bytes, each followed by LF (definitions column).
# status: merged (in the merged set), open (owning task not landed), decision (Reuben's call; defaults
#   to a named residual), unowned (no rule and no task). Single-family rows: a definition needing two
#   non-merged families is in neither row.
